根据叶形和环境判断陌生植物的习性。: Determine the habits of unfamiliar plants based on leaf shape and environment.
根据痕迹或物证推断发生过什么。: Infer what happened based on traces or physical evidence.
梦幻舞步 / 潇洒无畏: Dreamy Dance Steps / Chic and Fearless
检定计入双倍熟练加值。: The check counts as a double proficiency bonus.
检查物品的人做智力（调查）检定，成功可辨识原价。: The person inspecting the item must make an Intelligence (Investigation) check, and a successful check will reveal the original price.
模仿口音和扮演他人时尤其有用。: This is especially useful when imitating accents and pretending to be someone else.

次元镣铐与音爆号角无需同调。以下物品需同调：健康护符、山丘巨人之力腰带、浮空靴、: Dimensional Shackles and Sonic Boom Horn do not need to be in sync. The following items need to be synchronized: Amulet of Health, Belt of Hill Giant Strength, Boots of Levitation, Boots of Speed, Bracers of Defense, Bat Cloak, Gem of True Sight, Ring of Free Action, Ring of Protection, and Ram Ring.
次攻击，具体触发条件见职业能力。: Attack. For specific triggering conditions, see professional abilities.
欺瞒、洞悉及盗贼工具熟练，懂皮肤暗语。获得可在五套服装间切换的易纺服、一件纪念饰: Proficient in deception, insight, and thieves' tools, and understands skin code words. Gain the Easyspun Clothes that can be switched between five outfits, a commemorative charm, and 5 gp. Adapted from page 205 of the 2020 first edition of Exploring Eberron.
欺瞒与洞悉，盗贼工具、施毒工具或文书伪造工具任选一项，学鲨华鱼人语。获得贝壳、旅: Deception and insight, choose one of thieves' tools, poisoning tools or document forgery tools, and learn the language of sharks and fish. Get the shell, traveler’s clothes, and 30 gp. Adapted from page 207 of the 2020 first edition of Exploring Eberron.
欺瞒，加巧手或隐匿。易容、文书伪造或盗贼工具任选一项；学盗贼黑话。装备为普通服装: Deception, dexterity or Stealth. Choose between Disguise, Forgery, or Thieves' Tools; learn Thieves’ Cant. Equipment is common clothes, skilled tools, and 10 gp.
正常睡觉。免疫托梦术等要求目标做梦的魔法，睡眠术这类仅使你入睡的魔法仍然可以影响: Sleep normally. You are immune to magic that requires the target to dream, such as dreaming, and magic that only puts you to sleep, such as sleep, can still affect you.
此专长的旧版能力尚未核验，可在本级手填。: The old version of this feat has not yet been verified and can be filled in by hand at this level.
此处采用《瓦罗怪物指南》勘误，从驯兽、洞悉、威吓、医药、自然、察觉、求生中选两项: The errata of "Varro's Guide to Monsters" is used here. Choose two proficiencies from Animal Handling, insight, intimidation, medicine, nature, perception, and survival.
此扩展专长暂只有目录资料。: This extended expertise currently only has catalog information.
此能力尚无核验过的旧版说明。: There is no verified legacy description for this ability.
步行和游泳各 30 尺，可在空气和水中呼吸，但至少每 4 小时要浸水一次以免窒息: Walk and swim 30 feet each, and can breathe air and water, but must be immersed in water at least every 4 hours to avoid suffocation.
步行速度+10尺；已有攀爬或游泳速度同样+10尺。: Walking speed +10 feet; existing climbing or swimming speed also +10 feet.
步速 35 尺。能以敏捷施放迷踪步，长休恢复。: Pace 35 feet. Can cast Lost Step with agility and recover after a long rest.
步速较快，在轻度遮蔽的自然现象中也可尝试躲藏。: Move faster on foot and hide when lightly obscured by natural phenomena.
武僧穿护甲或装备盾牌时无法使用武艺与无甲移动。: Monks cannot use martial arts and move without armor when wearing armor or equipping a shield.
武器命中加卓越骰伤害，目标力量豁免失败则放下你选的一件持物。: When you hit with a weapon attack, add a superiority die to the damage. On a failed Strength saving throw, the target drops one object it is holding that you choose.
武器命中后，目标抵抗你在下回合结束前施放的下一个法术的首次豁免有劣势。: After your weapon hits a creature, it has disadvantage on its next saving throw against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.
武器命中已损失HP的目标额外1d8伤害，每回合一次。: The weapon hits a target that has lost HP for an additional 1d8 points of damage, once per round.
武器攻击掷18–20即重击。: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18, 19, or 20.
武器攻击掷19或20即重击。: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.
武器攻击检定可加卓越骰，应用攻击效果前决定。: Add a superiority die to a weapon attack roll. You can decide after rolling the attack, but before any of its effects are applied.
武艺伤害骰改为d10。: Your Martial Arts die increases to a d10.
武艺伤害骰改为d8。: Your Martial Arts die increases to a d8.
武道 · 游锋或兽痕: Martial Discipline: Traveler’s Blade or Weretouched
武道 · 铸心或魇幕: Martial Discipline: Forged Heart or Nightmare Shroud
每个你到访的城市都有一位联络人，能告诉你当地的人物和地点。按追捕对象所在的圈子联: Each city you visit has a contact person who can tell you about the people and places there. Contact people on the street, in the underground, or in high society according to the circle of the person being pursued.
每个你到访的城市都有一名联络人，能提供本地人物和地点的线索。根据追捕对象混迹的圈: In each city you visit, you have a contact who can point you toward local people and places. Look for a contact who moves in your quarry’s circles, whether on the street, in the underworld, or in high society.
每个自己回合一次，武器攻击失手可在同一动作中再作一次武器攻击。: Once per your turn, if you miss a weapon attack, you can make another weapon attack in the same action.
每个血猎手等级有一颗 d10 生命骰。1 级生命值上限为 10＋体质调整值；以后: You have one d10 Hit Die per blood hunter level. Your hit point maximum is 10 + your Constitution modifier at 1st level; add 1d10 (or 6) + your Constitution modifier for each later level. Gain proficiency with light armor, medium armor, shields, simple and martial weapons, alchemist’s supplies, and Dexterity and Intelligence saving throws. Choose three skill proficiencies from Acrobatics, Arcana, Athletics, History, Insight, Investigation, Religion, and Survival.
每个被召唤生物一枚冬青浆果: One holly berry per summoned creature
每件物品只能有一个效果。可同时维持智力调整值件物品，最少 1 件。效果没有固定时: Each object can have only one property. You can maintain properties on a number of objects equal to your Intelligence modifier, with a minimum of one. Remove a property by touching the object as an action. If you exceed the limit, the oldest property ends.
每名目标的当前和最大 HP 各增加: Each target's current and maximum HP are increased
每回合一次，以1环以上法术击杀一或多个生物时回复环阶×2HP，死灵法术×3，击杀: Once per turn when a spell of 1st level or higher kills a creature, regain twice the spell's level in hit points, or three times its level if it's a necromancy spell. Killing constructs or undead doesn't grant this healing.
每回合一次，以武器攻击命中生物时，可令它做感知豁免，DC＝8＋熟练加值＋本专长提: Once per round, when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cause it to make a Wisdom saving throw. DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + the attribute bonus adjusted by this feat. If you fail, the target panics you until the end of your next turn. On a success, it has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn. You may use your proficiency bonus once per long rest.

Once per round, when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cause it to make a Wisdom saving throw. DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + the attribute bonus adjusted by this feat. If you fail, the target panics you until the end of your next turn. On a success, it has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn. You have uses equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
每回合一次，以造成挥砍伤害的攻击命中生物时，可使它的速度减少 10 尺，直到你下: Once per turn, hitting a creature with an attack that deals slashing damage reduces its speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
每回合一次，以造成挥砍伤害的攻击命中生物时，可使它的速度减少 10 尺，直到你的: Once per turn, hitting a creature with an attack that deals slashing damage reduces its speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
每回合一次，以造成穿刺伤害的攻击命中生物时，可重掷这次攻击的一枚伤害骰，必须接受: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals piercing damage, you may reroll one damage die from that attack, and you must accept the new result.
每回合一次，以造成钝击伤害的攻击命中生物时，可将它移到相距 5 尺的空位。目标最: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals bludgeoning damage, you can move it to an open space 5 feet away. The target is no more than one size class larger than you.
每回合一次，你对 60 尺内可见生物造成伤害时，可再造成 1d6＋熟练加值的暗蚀: Once per round, when you deal damage to a visible creature within 60 feet, you can deal an additional 1d6 + proficiency bonus as necrotic damage and regain hit points equal to the actual necrotic damage. You have uses equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

Once per round, when you deal damage to a visible creature within 60 feet, you can deal an additional 1d6 + proficiency bonus as necrotic damage and regain hit points equal to the actual necrotic damage. You may use your proficiency bonus once per long rest.
每回合一次，对 60 尺内可见生物造成伤害时，可额外造成 1d8 力场伤害，并令: Once per round, when dealing damage to a visible creature within 60 feet, you deal an additional 1d8 force damage and require a Wisdom saving throw. DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + the Outer Plane scion's chosen spellcasting ability modifier. On failure, you are restrained until the start of your next turn. You may use your proficiency bonus once per long rest.

Once per round, when dealing damage to a visible creature within 60 feet, you deal an additional 1d8 force damage and require a Wisdom saving throw. DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + the Outer Plane scion's chosen spellcasting ability modifier. On failure, you are restrained until the start of your next turn. You have uses equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
每回合一次，对生物进行武器攻击检定时，可令检定具有优势。命中则伤害多加 1d8，: Once per turn, you can gain advantage on a weapon attack roll made against a creature. A hit increases the damage by 1d8 and consumes one use. Misses do not consume times, but still comply with the limit of once per round. You can successfully use your proficiency bonus a number of times per long rest.

Once per turn, you can gain advantage on a weapon attack roll made against a creature. A hit increases the damage by 1d8 and consumes one use. Misses do not consume times, but still comply with the limit of once per round. You can successfully use your proficiency bonus a number of times per long rest.
每回合一次，已使用反应后可花 1 气作额外反应。同一触发只能回应一次。: Once per turn, you can spend 1 ki for an additional reaction after a reaction has been used. The same trigger can only be responded to once.
每回合一次，当血猎手特性要求你掷鲜血秘法骰时，可重掷该骰并自选结果。用激活了猩红: Once per turn, when a blood hunter feature has you roll a Hemocraft die, you can reroll it and choose either result. When you score a critical hit with a weapon bearing an active Crimson Rite, regain one expended use of Blood Maledict.
每回合一次，某血猎手特性要求你投鲜血秘法骰时，可重掷其中一枚并任选一个结果。用激: Once per turn, when a blood hunter trait requires you to roll a blood arcane die, you can reroll one and choose a result. When a critical hit is made with a weapon that activates the Blood Gauge, a spent Blood Violence is restored.
每回合一次，法术伤害骰掷出最大值时，可选其中一个骰再掷并把结果加入伤害。: Once per turn, when a spell damage die rolls its maximum, you can reroll one such die and add the new roll to the damage.
每回合一次，用灵巧或远程武器命中且有优势时额外1d6；或目标5尺内有另一敌对未失: Once per turn, deal extra damage when you hit with a finesse or ranged weapon and have advantage. You can also qualify if another enemy of the target is within 5 feet of it, that enemy isn't incapacitated, and you don't have disadvantage. The extra damage starts at 1d6 and increases with rogue level.
每回合一次，近战武器攻击伤害可重掷武器伤害骰，选择其中一组结果。: Once per round, melee weapon attack damage rerolls the weapon damage die to choose one of the results.
每回合可用一个附赠动作疾走、撤离或躲藏。附赠动作仍只有一个；躲藏需要合理条件。: Each turn you can use a bonus action to sprint, retreat, or hide. There is still only one bonus action; hiding requires reasonable conditions.
每回合开始掷 d10。1–2：6d12 心灵并震慑。3–5：8d12 力场，敏捷: Roll a d10 at the beginning of each turn. 1–2: 6d12 Psychic and stunning. 3–5: 8d12 force damage, Dexterity saving throws half successful. 6–8: Teleport, 10d12 force damage and fall prone. 9–10: 10d12 Cold and blinded.
每回合开始时若HP大于0且不超过一半，回复5+体质调整值HP。: At the start of your turn, regain 5 + your Constitution modifier hit points if you have at least 1 hit point and no more than half your hit point maximum.
每天可向愿意听的人讲一次故事；DM 可令部分听众因此变得友善。这不是魔法，后续态: A story can be told once a day to anyone willing to listen; DM can make some listeners friendly as a result. It's not magic, and subsequent attitudes change based on your behavior.
每天可行进最多 16 小时，之后才承受强行军的影响；也能找到把船安全靠岸的路线。: It is possible to travel for up to 16 hours per day before suffering the effects of forced marches; routes can also be found to bring the ship safely to shore.
每奇械师等级有一颗 d8 生命骰。1 级生命上限为 8＋体质调整值，之后每级增加: Your Hit Die is a d8. At 1st level your hit point maximum is 8 + your Constitution modifier. At later levels, add 1d8 or 5, plus your Constitution modifier. You are proficient in Constitution and Intelligence saving throws. Choose two skills from Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Perception, and Sleight of Hand.
每奇械师等级有一颗 d8 生命骰。1 级生命值上限为 8＋体质调整值，之后每级增: Your Hit Die is a d8. At 1st level your hit point maximum is 8 + your Constitution modifier. At later levels, add 1d8 or 5, plus your Constitution modifier. You are proficient in Constitution and Intelligence saving throws. Choose two skills from Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Perception, and Sleight of Hand.
每实际经过10年只衰老1年。: For every ten years that pass, your body ages only one year.
每日一次短休时恢复总环阶至多半德鲁伊等级（向上取整）的法术位，不能恢复6环及以上: Once per day during a short rest, recover expended spell slots with a combined level up to half your druid level, rounded up. You can't recover a slot of 6th level or higher.
每日一次，在短休后恢复总环阶至多半法师等级（向上取整）的法术位，不能恢复6环或更: Once per day after a short rest, recover expended spell slots whose combined levels total no more than half your wizard level, rounded up. You can't recover slots of 6th level or higher this way.
每日一次，长休后花 1 小时，用纸和墨水制作一张已知或已准备法术的卷轴。最高环阶: Once per day, spend 1 hour after a long rest, use paper and ink to create a scroll of a known or prepared spell. The highest level is half the proficiency bonus (rounded down).
每日首次施1环以上防护法术可造守御，最大HP=法师等级×2+智力调整值，先替你承: When you cast an abjuration spell of 1st level or higher, you can create a ward that takes damage in your place. Its hit point maximum is twice your wizard level + your Intelligence modifier. Later abjuration spells of 1st level or higher restore 2 ward hit points per spell level.
每月缴 5 gp 会费。公会可在需要时提供食宿、同行及生意人脉，或为能证明清白、: Pay monthly dues of 5 gp. The guild can provide food and accommodation, peers and business contacts when needed, or provide support to members who can prove their innocence and still have room for defense; the arrears must be paid before benefits can be restored.
每束各做一次远程法术攻击，可指向同一目标或不同目标。: Make a separate ranged spell attack for each beam. You can direct the beams at one creature or split them among targets.
每枚 1d4 + 1 力场（1 环 3 枚）: 1d4 + 1 force damage per dart (three darts with a 1st-spell slot)
每枚已知符文各能激活两次，完成短休或长休恢复。: You can invoke each rune twice between short or long rests.
每次 1d6 HP。整次法术治疗次数为 1 + 施法属性调整值，至少 2 次（旧: 1d6 HP each time. The number of times a spell heals is 1 + your spellcasting ability modifier, at least 2 times (legacy errata).
每次完成长休后选强酸、寒冷或火焰，获得相应伤害抗性，持续至下次完成长休。: After each long rest, choose acid, cold, or fire to gain the corresponding damage resistance until the next long rest is completed.
每次完成长休后，可以逐件触碰符合条件的非魔法物品并施加注法。每项已知注法同一时间: After a long rest, touch eligible nonmagical objects to infuse them. Each infusion can affect only one object at a time, and an object can hold only one infusion. You can attune to the item immediately if it requires attunement, or attune later as normal.
每次完成长休时，可以触碰一把简易或军用武器，或一件你可用来作法器的物品，从奇械师: Each time you finish a long rest, you can touch a simple or martial weapon, or an object that you can use as a spellcasting focus, to save a 1st- or 2nd-level spell from the artificer's spell list with a casting time of 1 action, without preparation. The creature holding the object can use an object action to produce the spell's effects, using your spellcasting ability. If concentration is required, it is maintained by the creature activating the item. The stored method lasts until the number of times is used up or you store the method again. Number of uses = twice Intelligence modifier, minimum 2 times.
每次掷浪潮表改掷两个 d8 取其一，两骰相同时可任选表上一项。: Each time you roll the tide table, roll one of the two d8s. If the two dice are the same, you can choose the one on the table.
每次攻击命中受诅咒目标，额外 1d6 暗蚀。: Each attack hits a cursed target for an additional 1d6 necrosis.
每次武器攻击命中标记目标，额外 1d6 伤害。: Each weapon attack hits the marked target for an additional 1d6 damage.
每次涂毒后可保持 1 分钟，使用该武器或弹药命中便提前耗掉。受到这次攻击伤害的生: The poison lasts for 1 minute after each application, and is consumed in advance if hit with the weapon or ammunition. A creature damaged by this attack makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, you take 2d8 poison damage and are poisoned until the end of your next turn.

The poison lasts for 1 minute after each application, and is consumed in advance if hit with the weapon or ammunition. A creature damaged by this attack makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, you take 2d8 poison damage and are poisoned until the end of your next turn.
每次用动作、附赠动作或反应射击时，通常最多射一发。: Each time you fire as an action, bonus action, or reaction, you usually fire a maximum of one shot.
每次短休恢复4术法点。: Regain 4 expended sorcery points whenever you finish a short rest.
每次短休或长休可恢复三次引导神力。: You can use Channel Divinity three times between short or long rests.
每次短休或长休可恢复两次引导神力。: You can use Channel Divinity twice between short or long rests.
每次短休或长休后获得一项原本不熟练的技能或工具，持续到用此能力换成别项。自己回合: After each short or long rest, you gain a skill or tool with which you were not proficient. This lasts until you exchange that ability for another. After making a sneak attack on your own turn, another visible creature within 30 feet of the original target may take half the sneak attack die (rounded up) as necrotic damage; proficiency bonus per long rest.
每次进入狂暴选一种天生武器，到狂暴结束。这些算简易近战武器，力量决定命中和伤害。: Each time you enter a rage, choose a natural weapon until the rage ends. These are considered simple melee weapons, and their strength determines their hit and damage. The bite is 1d8 piercings, once per your turn, and restores proficiency bonus point HP when hitting a creature with less than half HP. You can use your claws as 1d6 slashes with your bare hand, and you can make one additional claw strike each round when you use your claws for the first time as an attack action. The tail is 1d8 piercing and touching. When a visible creature within 10 feet hits you, you can use your reaction to add 1d8 to your AC to determine whether you still hit.

Each time you enter a rage, choose a natural weapon until the rage ends. These are considered simple melee weapons, and their strength determines their hit and damage. The bite is 1d8 piercings, once per your turn, and restores proficiency bonus point hit points when hitting a creature with less than half hit points. You can use your claws as 1d6 slashes with your bare hand, and you can make one additional claw strike each round when you use your claws for the first time as an attack action. The tail is 1d8 piercing and touching. When a visible creature within 10 feet hits you, you can use your reaction to add 1d8 to your AC to determine whether you still hit.
每次远程攻击消耗一发弹药。单手弹药武器通常需要一只空手装填。: Each ranged attack consumes one ammo. One-handed ammunition weapons usually require an empty hand to be loaded.
每次长休后可用羽笔和空白纸（魔典在 5 尺内）制作一张仅你可读的法术卷轴。选书内: After each long rest, you can use a quill and blank paper (the grimoire is within 5 feet) to create a spell scroll that only you can read. Select a 1st or 2nd level spell in the scroll with a casting time of one action, cast the scroll one level higher, and read it as an action. The writing disappears after use or the next long rest. The cost and time of making a normal spell scroll with a quill is halved.
每次长休后选钝击、穿刺、挥砍、寒冷、闪电、暗蚀、心灵或雷鸣。你自己回合首次徒手命: Choose bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, cold, lightning, necrotic, psychic, or thunder after each long rest. The first time you hit a creature with your bare hands during your turn, you deal an additional 1d6 points of damage of this type, up to 2d6 points at 11th level. When choosing the first three categories, the attached damage is also the magic damage of the air strike.
每次长休末掷任一骰，偶数给吉兆，奇数给凶兆，持续到下次长休结束。30 尺内可见生: At the end of each long rest, roll any dice. An even number will give a good omen, and an odd number will give a bad omen. This lasts until the end of the next long rest. Creatures visible within 30 feet make attack, ability, or saving throws, with available reactions plus 1d6 for good omen or minus 1d6 for ill omen. You have uses equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

The following items need to be attuned: Jumping Boots, Snow Boots, Archer's Bracers, Shield Brooch, Protective Cloak, Eagle Eye Lenses, Ogre Power Gloves, Arrow Seizing Gloves, Climbing Swimming Gloves, Disguise Hat, Intelligence Headband, Telepathic Helmet, Mind Reading Medal, Adaptation Necklace, Healing Amulet, Rat Calling Music, Jump Ring, Psychic Shield Ring, Spider Shoes, Wing Boots.
花 1 小时或在完成长休时制作熟练加值份餐点，制成后 8 小时内有效。生物可用附: Spend 1 hour or when you finish a long rest to craft a proficiency bonus meal, which is valid for 8 hours. The creature can eat a portion as a bonus action, gaining temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.
花 2 气施放，免材料成分。: Spends 2 Chi to cast, no material component required.
花 3 术法点和附赠动作，选 120 尺内可见的一个猎物，在它 30 尺内空位召: Spend 3 sorcery points and a bonus action to select a prey item visible within 120 feet and summon it in an open space within 30 feet of it. The hound rolls initiative alone and can only pursue the target by the shortest route and attack the target with an action or opportunity. At the beginning of the round, you know the prey's location and ignore its hiding. Crossing objects and creatures is treated as difficult terrain, and the object is subject to 5 force fields at the end of the turn. While it is within 5 feet of the prey, the prey has disadvantage on all saving throws against your spells. Disappears after 5 minutes or when the hound or prey drops to 0 HP.
花 6 术法点并用附赠动作化影 1 分钟。除力场和光耀之外，对所有伤害有抗性，可: Spend 6 sorcery points and use the bonus action to manifest for 1 minute. It is resistant to all damage except force fields and radiance, and can pass through creatures and objects as difficult terrain. At the end of the turn, the body is subject to 5 force fields within objects. It can end prematurely by being incapacitated, dying, or dispelling it with a bonus action.
花10分钟激励至多6名能理解你的友方，给予等级+魅力调整值的临时HP；每个目标每: Spend 10 minutes inspiring up to 6 understanding allies, granting temporary hit points equal to their level + Charisma modifier; once per short or long rest for each target.
花1分钟以自然材料伪装，贴着合适表面不动时，隐匿+10；移动、动作或反应终止。再: Spend 1 minute making camouflage. While pressed against a suitable surface without moving, taking an action, or reacting, you gain +10 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks. You also choose another favored terrain at this level.
花1分钟恢复所有契约法术位，每长休一次。: Spend 1 minute asking your patron for aid to regain all expended Pact Magic spell slots. You can do this once per long rest.
花1点，使至少5尺的距离加倍，或将触碰改为30尺。: Spend 1 sorcery point to double a spell range of at least 5 feet, or change a range of touch to 30 feet.
花1点，持续至少1分钟的法术持续时间翻倍，至多24小时。: Spend 1 sorcery point to double a duration of at least 1 minute, up to a maximum of 24 hours.
花1点，指定至多魅力调整值名生物自动成功于这次法术豁免。: Spend 1 sorcery point to let chosen creatures automatically succeed on their saving throws against the spell. Choose up to your Charisma modifier in creatures, with a minimum of one.
花1点，省去言语和姿势成分。: Spend 1 sorcery point to cast the spell without verbal or somatic components.
花1点，重掷至多魅力调整值个法术伤害骰并采用新结果，可与其他超魔法同用。: Spend 1 sorcery point to reroll up to your Charisma modifier in damage dice, with a minimum of one, and use the new rolls. You can use this even if you used another Metamagic option on the spell.
花2气施展燃烧之手。: Spend 2 ki to cast Burning Hands.
花2气施展雷鸣波。: Spend 2 ki to cast Thunder Wave.
花2点，把施法时间1动作改为附赠动作；仍受附赠动作施法规则限制。: Spend 2 sorcery points to cast a spell that normally takes 1 action as a bonus action. The normal bonus-action spellcasting restriction still applies.
花3气施展人类定身术。: Spend 3 qi to cast the Human Hold Technique.
花3气施展粉碎音波。: Spend 3 qi to cast Shattering Sound Wave.
花3点，令一个目标对该法术的第一次豁免有劣势。: Spend 3 sorcery points to give one target disadvantage on its first saving throw against the spell.
花4气对自己施气化形体。: Spend 4 qi on yourself to transform yourself into a physical form.
花4气对自己施飞行术。: Spend 4 ki to cast flying spell on yourself.
花5气对自己施石肤术。: Spend 5 ki to cast Stoneskin on yourself.
花5气施展火墙术。: Spend 5 qi to cast Wall of Fire.
花6气施展寒冰锥。: Spend 6 qi to cast Cone of Ice.
花6气施展石墙术。: Spend 6 qi to cast stone wall.
花7天及25gp建立一个新身份，备齐历史、职业和关系。正确易容后一般能使人相信，: Spend seven days and 25 gp to establish a false identity with a history, occupation, and contacts. People generally accept your disguise as that person unless they have a clear reason to doubt it.
花7天和25金币建立一个不存在的新身份，包含历史、职业和关系。妥善易容采用该身份: Spend 7 days and 25 gold coins to build a new identity that doesn't exist, complete with history, career, and relationships. After a properly disguised person adopts this identity, others usually believe it until obvious contrary evidence is obtained; this ability cannot be used to directly impersonate an existing person.
花8小时造石，携带者获得选定的黑暗视觉、速度+10、体质豁免熟练或一种元素抗性；: Spend eight hours making a stone that grants its bearer your choice of darkvision, 10 feet of extra speed, Constitution saving throw proficiency, or resistance to a listed damage type. You can change the benefit when you cast a transmutation spell of 1st level or higher while carrying it.
花时间观察目标，为下回合针对它的一次攻击取得优势。: Study a target now to gain advantage on your first attack roll against it on your next turn, provided you maintain concentration.
苑像在你 60 尺内时，可用动作和它交换位置。若任一方无法在另一方的空间容纳自己: While your mascot is within 60 feet, use an action to swap places with it. If either of you cannot fit in the destination space, the swap fails but still expends the use. You can use this feature once per long rest, or expend a spell slot of 2nd level or higher to use it again.
苑像在你 60 尺内时，用动作与它交换位置。目的地容不下你时仍消耗这次机会。完成: While the garden statue is within 60 feet of you, use your action to swap places with it. Use this opportunity even if your destination cannot accommodate you. Restore free times after finishing a long rest, or spend 2nd level or higher spell slots to use again.

若 DM 允许赎罪，须先离开邪恶阵营并以行动证明。失去破誓者能力，选神祇和誓言并: If the DM allows atonement, you must first leave the evil alignment and prove it with actions. Lose the oathbreaker ability, choose a deity and oath, and complete the trials specified by the DM before gaining the new oath ability. Once the oath is broken again, there can be no atonement.
若你与上次使用的位面传送门位于同一位面，你始终知道门相对你的方向。另可用动作得知: If you are on the same plane as the last plane portal you used, you always know the door's direction relative to you. You can also use your actions to learn the location of portals within 30 feet that are not covered by total cover. After successfully detecting the portal, you cannot perform this action again before taking a long rest.
若你拥有适用的仪式施法能力，可以多花 10 分钟作为仪式施放，不消耗法术位。不同: With the appropriate Ritual Casting feature, you can add 10 minutes to the casting time and cast without a spell slot. Check your class rules for whether the spell must be known, prepared, or in your spellbook.
若奥秘阻绝使非当前位面原住民豁免失败，且 CR 不超过门槛，改为放逐 1 分钟，: If the arcane block causes a non-native of the current plane to fail a saving throw and the CR does not exceed the threshold, it is instead exiled for 1 minute without concentration. Cleric level 5/8/11/14/17 thresholds are CR 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 4.
若尚不熟练于制毒工具，获得该项熟练。用制毒工具工作 1 小时并消耗 50 gp: If you are not already proficient in poisoner’s kit, gain this proficiency. Work with the poison tool for 1 hour and spend 50 gp of materials to create a poison worth the proficiency bonus.
若目标被你突袭，且你在这场战斗的第一个回合以攻击命中它，该次攻击可多造成 2d6: If the target is surprised by you and you hit it with an attack on the first turn of this combat, the attack deals an additional 2d6 points of damage. Once per battle.
若职业和背景给了同一种熟练，可以与 DM 确定如何替换重复的熟练。背景起始物品与: If a class and background grant the same proficiency, work with the DM to determine how to replace the duplicate proficiency. Background starting items and gold coins are processed according to the starting equipment method used.
若野兽本回合未攻击，可附赠动作命令它疾走、撤离或协助；其攻击视为魔法以克服抗性或: On a turn when your companion doesn't attack, you can use a bonus action to command it to Dash, Disengage, or Help. Its attacks count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

获得 60 尺黑暗视觉，已有种族黑暗视觉则延长 30 尺。在黑暗中，依靠黑暗视觉: Gain darkvision for 60 feet, extending darkvision for existing races by 30 feet. In darkness, creatures that rely on darkvision to see you see you as invisible.

进入狂暴时选 30 尺内可见且自愿的其他生物，数量至多为体质调整值且至少可选一名: When you enter a rage, you can choose up to one other willing creature within 30 feet of you, up to your Constitution modifier, and at least one of your choice. Each gives you 5 temporary HP. Once per turn while the rage lasts, the chosen one can add 1d6 to an attack roll that hits and deals damage. Proficiency bonus times, restored on long rest.

When you enter a rage, you can choose up to one other willing creature within 30 feet of you, up to your Constitution modifier, and at least one of your choice. Each gives you 5 temporary hit points. Once per turn while the rage lasts, the chosen one can add 1d6 to an attack roll that hits and deals damage. You have uses equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
进行一次近战武器攻击。可让火焰跳向主目标 5 尺内的另一生物。: Make a melee weapon attack. Causes the fire to jump to another creature within 5 feet of the primary target.
进行一次远程法术攻击。命中造成 2d8＋1d6 伤害，从两个 d8 的结果中选一: Make a ranged spell attack. One of the two d8s determines the damage type. If the d8s match, the bolt can leap to another creature.
进行一种仪式，如祝福婚礼、赎罪或制作圣水，效果随所选仪式而变。: Perform a religious rite, such as atonement, a wedding, or blessing holy water. The effect depends on the rite you choose.
进行可加入熟练加值的属性检定时，d20的1–9视为10。不适用于攻击检定和豁免。: For ability checks that add proficiency bonuses, d20 numbers 1–9 are treated as 10. Does not apply to attack rolls and saving throws.
进行感知（医药）或使用草药工具的属性检定时，可额外掷 1d4 加入检定结果。: When you make a Wisdom (Medicine) check or an ability check using an herbalism kit, roll a d4 and add it to the result.
进行感知（察觉）或感知（求生）检定时，可额外掷 1d4 加入检定结果。: When you make a Wisdom (Perception or Survival) check, roll a d4 and add it to the result.
进行感知（洞悉）或感知（察觉）检定时，可额外掷 1d4 加入检定结果。: When you make a Wisdom (Insight or Perception) check, roll a d4 and add it to the result.
进行感知（驯兽）或智力（自然）检定时，可额外掷 1d4 加入检定结果。: When you make a Wisdom (Animal Handling) or Intelligence (Nature) check, roll a d4 and add it to the result.
进行敏捷（特技）或使用领航工具的属性检定时，可额外掷 1d4 加入检定结果。: When you make a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or an ability check using navigator’s tools, roll a d4 and add it to the result.
进行敏捷（特技）或操控、维护陆上载具的属性检定时，可额外掷 1d4 加入检定结果: When you make a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or an ability check to operate or maintain a land vehicle, roll a d4 and add it to the result.
进行敏捷（隐匿）检定时，可令该次检定具有优势。: When making a Dexterity (Stealth) check, you have advantage on that check.
进行敏捷（隐匿）检定时，可令该次检定具有优势。使用次数等于熟练加值，长休恢复。: When you make a Dexterity (Stealth) check, you can give yourself advantage. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
进行敏捷（隐匿）检定时，可令该次检定具有优势。可用次数等于熟练加值，长休恢复。: When you make a Dexterity (Stealth) check, you can give yourself advantage. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
进行智力（历史）或使用书法工具的属性检定时，可额外掷 1d4 加入检定结果。: When you make an Intelligence (History) check or an ability check using calligrapher’s supplies, roll a d4 and add it to the result.
进行智力（奥秘）或使用工匠工具的属性检定时，可额外掷 1d4 加入检定结果。: When you make an Intelligence (Arcana) check or an ability check using artisan’s tools, roll a d4 and add it to the result.
进行智力（调查）或使用盗贼工具的属性检定时，可额外掷 1d4 加入检定结果。: When you make an Intelligence (Investigation) check or an ability check using thieves’ tools, roll a d4 and add it to the result.
进行智力（调查）或感知（洞悉）检定时，可额外掷 1d4 加入检定结果。: When you make an Intelligence (Investigation) or Wisdom (Insight) check, roll a d4 and add it to the result.
进行涉及技能的属性检定时，可在看到 d20 结果后掷 d6 加入检定。: When making an ability check involving a skill, you can see the d20 result and then roll a d6 to add to the roll.
进行涉及技能的属性检定时，可在看到 d20 结果后掷 d6 加入检定。使用次数等: When you make an ability check using a skill, you can roll a d6 after seeing the d20 and add it to the check. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
进行涉及技能的属性检定时，可在看到 d20 结果后掷 d6 加入检定。可用次数等: When you make an ability check using a skill, you can roll a d6 after seeing the d20 and add it to the check. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
进行远程法术攻击，命中造成 1d10 穿刺伤害。无论是否命中，冰刃都在目标处爆开: Make a ranged spell attack for piercing damage. The shard then explodes whether it hits or misses, forcing nearby creatures to save against cold damage.
进行魅力（游说）或使用酿酒工具、厨师工具的属性检定时，可额外掷 1d4 加入检定: When you make a Charisma (Persuasion) check or an ability check using brewer’s supplies or cook’s utensils, roll a d4 and add it to the result.
进行魅力（游说）检定时，额外加上感知调整值。你还获得感知豁免熟练；若已有这项熟练: Add your Wisdom modifier to Charisma (Persuasion) checks. You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws. If you already have it, choose proficiency in Intelligence or Charisma saving throws instead.
进行魅力（表演）或敏捷（隐匿）检定时，可额外掷 1d4 加入检定结果。: When you make a Charisma (Performance) or Dexterity (Stealth) check, roll a d4 and add it to the result.
远古秘密之书的初始仪式: The Initiating Ritual of the Book of Ancient Secrets
远程光耀攻击，命中后让下一次攻击该目标更有利。: Make a ranged spell attack for radiant damage. A hit grants advantage on the next attack roll against the target before the end of your next turn.
远程寒冷攻击，并暂时降低目标速度。: Make a ranged spell attack that deals cold damage and reduces the target's speed by 10 feet until your next turn.
远程攻击命中后，削弱目标以力量进行的武器伤害。: On a ranged spell attack hit, the target deals half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength until it saves or the spell ends.
远程暗蚀攻击，并暂时阻止命中目标恢复生命。: Make a ranged spell attack that deals necrotic damage and prevents the target from regaining hit points until your next turn. Undead you hit also have disadvantage on attacks against you.
远程武器攻击检定+2。: +2 to attack rolls with ranged weapons.
远程武器长射程攻击不因距离有劣势，忽略半身和四分之三掩护；熟练远程武器攻击可选命: Long-range attacks with long-range weapons have no disadvantage due to distance and ignore half-body and three-quarter cover; proficient long-range weapon attacks can choose -5 hit and +10 damage.
远程毒素攻击，命中后可能令目标中毒。: Make a ranged spell attack for poison damage. On a hit, the target may also become poisoned.
远程法术攻击。两枚 d8 相同则可跳至另一目标，对其另掷攻击和伤害。: Remote magic attack. If two d8s are the same, you can jump to another target and roll another attack and damage to it.
远程法术攻击命中后，目标在你下回合结束前受到的下一次攻击获得优势。: After a ranged spell attack hits, the target gains advantage on the next attack it receives before the end of your next turn.
远程法术攻击造成 1d10 力场伤害，5、11、17 级分别增加一束独立射线。: Make a ranged spell attack for 1d10 force damage. At character levels 5, 11, and 17, add a beam with its own attack roll.
远程法术攻击造成 1d10 火焰伤害，随等级提升。也能点燃暴露的可燃物。: Make a ranged spell attack for 1d10 fire damage. The damage increases at character levels 5, 11, and 17. A flammable object you hit ignites if nobody is wearing or carrying it.
远程法术攻击造成由骰面决定类型的伤害，两个 d8 相同可让能量跳向新目标。: Make a ranged spell attack. One of the two d8s determines the damage type. If the d8s match, the bolt can leap to another creature.
远程游荡者也能在城市利用反应脱离近身；自然与求生偏荒野。: Long-range rogues can also use reactions to escape from close range in the city; nature and survival tend to be in the wilderness.
远程酸液攻击，命中后还会在稍后造成额外伤害。: Make a ranged spell attack. A hit deals acid damage immediately and again at the end of the target's next turn. A miss deals half the initial damage.
连接两名生物的生命，使一方承受的伤害或治疗传递给另一方。: Link two creatures so that damage or healing received by one is also applied to the other.
迫使听见你的生物按你指定的方向移动。: Force affected creatures that can hear you to move in a direction you choose.
迫使目标跳舞，妨碍移动和防御，目标可花动作尝试摆脱。: Make a creature dance in place, hindering its movement and combat rolls. It can spend an action to attempt a Wisdom saving throw to stop.
迫使目标面对你，使它攻击别人和远离你更困难。: On a failed Wisdom saving throw, a creature has disadvantage on attacks against others and must make a Wisdom saving throw when it tries to move more than 30 feet from you.
迷踪步、行动无踪: Wandering steps, moving without a trace
追加 2d6 心灵伤害（4d6）。感知豁免失败时，目标只能看清自己 5 尺以内，: Adds 2d6 psychic damage (4d6). On a failed Wisdom saving throw, the target can only see within 5 feet of itself until the beginning of your next turn.
追加 2d6 心灵伤害（4d6），指定目标身边 30 尺内一名盟友。感知豁免失败: Adds 2d6 psychic damage (4d6) to an ally within 30 feet of the target. On a failed Wisdom save, the target is charmed by the ally until the beginning of your next turn, or the ally attacks, damages the target, or causes it to save.
追加 2d6 暗蚀伤害（4d6），目标体质豁免失败后武器攻击的伤害减半，直到你下: Adds 2d6 necrotic damage (4d6), and weapon attacks that cause the target to fail its Constitution save take half damage until the start of your next turn.
追加 2d6 毒素伤害（4d6），目标速度减 10 尺，每回合首次移动至少 1: It takes an additional 2d6 poison damage (4d6), the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet, and it takes an additional 2d6 slashing damage (4d6) the first time each round it moves at least 1 foot without teleporting. The target or someone who can touch it can use an action to dismantle it with a Strength (Athletics) vs. Shot DC. Ends after 1 minute or when you use this option again.
追踪、找路，或识别野外的危险。: Track, find your way, or identify hazards in the wild.
追踪妖精、邪魔或不死生物时，你的感知（求生）检定具有优势；回忆与它们有关的知识时: You have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track Fey, Fiends, or Undead and on Intelligence checks to recall information about them. Hemocraft save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Hemocraft modifier. This builder defaults to Intelligence; record Wisdom manually if your DM uses the author’s Wisdom option.
追踪此类生物的求生和回忆其知识的智力检定有优势。: There is advantage on Intelligence checks to track the survival of such a creature and to recall its knowledge.
适合你宗教信仰的熏香和祭品，总共价值至少 25gp，作为该法术的耗材: Incense and offerings appropriate to your religious beliefs, worth at least 25 gp in total, serve as consumables for this spell
适合准备伏击和长期潜入的角色。: Suitable for characters preparing for ambushes and long-term infiltrations.
适合想借用亡者知识和灵魂力量的角色。: Suitable for characters who want to borrow the knowledge and soul power of the dead.
适合擅长协助队友和收集人际信息的角色。: Suitable for characters who are good at assisting teammates and gathering interpersonal information.
适合文书、密码和语言主题；不自动增加伪造工具熟练。: Good for clerical, cryptographic, and language topics; does not automatically increase forgery tool proficiency.
适合潜入；隐形术仍需专注且受法术本身终止条件约束。: Good for stealth; invisibility still requires concentration and is subject to the spell's own termination conditions.
适合需要提高生命上限的角色。: Suitable for characters who need to increase their life limit.
适合靠手艺而非魔法潜入。城市环境可多用绳索、门锁与日常道具。: Suitable for sneaking in using craftsmanship rather than magic. Ropes, door locks and everyday props can be used in urban environments.
适应深海环境，获得寒冷伤害抗性。: Adapt to the deep sea environment and gain resistance to cold damage.
适用山地旅行及环境检定。: Suitable for mountain travel and environmental testing.
适用幽暗地域旅行及环境检定。: Suitable for Underdark travel and environment checks.
适用极地旅行及环境检定。: Suitable for polar travel and environmental tests.
适用森林旅行及环境检定。: Applicable to forest travel and environmental tests.
适用沙漠旅行及环境检定。: Suitable for desert travel and environmental testing.
适用沼泽旅行及环境检定。: Suitable for Swamp Travel and Environment checks.
适用海岸旅行及环境检定。: Suitable for coastal travel and environmental testing.
适用草原旅行及环境检定。: Applicable to grassland travel and environmental tests.
选 2 项战技，可替换 1 项旧战技。: Choose 2 combat skills to replace 1 old combat skill.
选 3 项战技和一项工匠工具熟练。: Choose 3 Combat Skills and 1 Artisan Tool Proficiency.
选 4 项已知注法，最多维持 2 件注法物品。: Choose 4 known infusions and maintain up to 2 infusion items.
选 4 项注法学会，最多同时维持 2 件注法物品。到 6、10、14、18 级时: Learn four infusions and maintain up to two infused items at a time. At levels 6, 10, 14, and 18, your infusions known rise to 6, 8, 10, and 12, while your maximum infused items rise to 3, 4, 5, and 6. You can replace one infusion whenever you gain an artificer level.
选「下载离线工具」，保存 HTML 后用浏览器打开。网页版和离线版各自保存角色，: Choose Download Offline Tool, then open the saved HTML file in a browser. The online and offline versions keep separate saves; move characters between them with a JSON save.
选一个 1 环和一个 2 环法术作为精通法术。: Choose one 1st-level spell and one 2nd-level spell as the mastery spell.
选一个6环邪术师法术，每长休免费施放一次；它独立于契约法术位。: Choose a 6th-level warlock spell as your arcanum. Cast it once without spending a spell slot, and regain the use after a long rest.
选一个专业。塔莎版包含炼金师、魔炮师、战地匠师和装甲师。这个选择在奇械师 3、5: Choose a major. Tasha's version includes Alchemist, Magic Cannonist, Field Craftsman, and Armorer. This choice unlocks the corresponding subclass abilities at Artificer levels 3, 5, 9, and 15 respectively.
选一个德鲁伊戏法作为牧师戏法，并在驯兽、自然、求生中选一项熟练。: Learn a druid cantrip that counts as a cleric cantrip for you. Gain proficiency in Animal Handling, Nature, or Survival.
选一个德鲁伊戏法，并从驯兽、自然、求生中选一项熟练。: Choose a druid cantrip and choose a proficiency from Animal Handling, Nature, or Survival.
选一个法师戏法，再选一轮月亮并从其四个一环法术中选两个。选智力、感知或魅力作为本: Choose a wizard cantrip, choose a moon and choose two of its four first-level spells. Choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as the spellcasting ability for this feat. Each of the two first-level spells can be cast once without a spell slot. They can be recovered separately after a long rest. They can also be cast using a suitable spell slot.
选一个满足前提的专长。另选 60 尺黑暗视觉或一项技能熟练。判定特定种族前提时使: Choose a feat that meets the prerequisites. Alternatively choose darkvision 60 ft. Or proficiency in a skill. The custom bloodline itself is used when determining race-specific prerequisites.
选一件看得见且没被其他生物穿戴或携带的物品。录入一段最多 25 个词的话，并指定: Choose a visible object no other creature is wearing or carrying. Record up to 25 words and choose a visual or audible trigger.
选一位原先信奉的叛神。智力（宗教）检定用于回想该信仰的资料时有优势，包括非公开的: Choose a rebel god you originally believed in. Intelligence (religion) checks are made with advantage to recall material about the faith, including non-public teachings; negotiate with the DM a secret previously learned in the order.
选一位宗主：至高妖精、天界、深海意志、邪魔、巨灵、旧日支配者、咒剑、死灵或不朽者: Choose a suzerain: High Fairy, Celestial, Will of the Deep, Demon, Djinn, Old One, Cursed Sword, Undead or Immortal. This choice determines the enchantments of the blood instrument, as well as the additional spells gained at 7th and 15th levels.
选一双靴子，需同调。穿戴者可用附赠动作传送到 15 尺内看得见的空位，目的地必须: When choosing a pair of boots, they need to be in the same style. The wearer can use a bonus action to teleport to a visible empty space within 15 feet. The destination must be a location the wearer has already visited during the current turn.
选一名你可见的生物。其攻击检定有优势，属性检定有劣势。: Choose a creature you can see. It has advantage on attack rolls and disadvantage on ability checks.
选一套盔甲或一面盾牌。穿戴盔甲或持用盾牌时 AC 加 1。制作者达到 10 级奇: Choose a suit of armor or a shield. Add 1 to AC when wearing armor or wielding a shield. Once the creator reaches 10th level as an artificer, the bonus increases to 2.
选一套盔甲或法袍。物品有 4 发充能。穿戴者维持法术专注的体质豁免失败时，可用反: Choose a suit of armor or robes. Item has 4 charges. If the wearer fails a Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration on the spell, he can use his reaction to change the saving throw to a success by spending 1 round. Restores 1d4 spent charges each dawn.
选一套盔甲，需同调。施加注法时为穿戴者指定一种伤害抗性，可选强酸、寒冷、火焰、力: To choose a set of armor, it needs to be in sync. When an infusion is applied, it assigns the wearer a damage resistance, one of which is acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic damage, poison, psychic, radiance, or thunder.
选一套盔甲，需同调。最多 6 发充能。穿戴者做力量检定或力量豁免时，可花 1 发: To choose a set of armor, it needs to be in sync. Up to 6 charges. When the wearer makes a Strength check or Strength saving throw, he can spend 1 charge and add his Intelligence modifier to the check. When you are about to fall to the ground, you can use your reaction to spend 1 shot to avoid falling to the ground. Restores 1d6 spent charges per dawn.
选一套盔甲，需同调。穿戴者步行速度加 5 尺。空手时，每只手套可作一把穿戴者熟练: To choose a set of armor, it needs to be in sync. The wearer's walking speed increases by 5 feet. When unarmed, each glove functions as a magical melee weapon with which the wearer is proficient, dealing 1d8 force damage on hit. The glove can be thrown, with a normal range of 20 feet and a maximum range of 60 feet. It returns immediately after attacking and takes back the armor. Armor cannot be removed without the consent of the wearer. Armor replaces missing limbs or similar parts, allowing those parts to be used as normal.
选一把有弹药属性的简易或军用武器，需同调。用它作远程攻击时，命中检定和伤害掷骰加: Choose a simple or military weapon with ammunition attributes, which needs to be synchronized. When used as a ranged attack, add 1 to hit rolls and damage rolls, ignoring the loading attribute. When the weapon has no ammunition, each time it launches a long-range attack, it will automatically generate a magic ammunition, which will disappear immediately after a hit or miss.
选一把有投掷属性的简易或军用武器。用它进行的攻击检定和伤害掷骰均加 1。用它发动: Choose a simple or military weapon with throwing properties. Add 1 to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. After using it to launch a ranged attack, regardless of whether it hits or misses, the weapon immediately returns to the user's hand.
选一把简易或军用武器。用它进行攻击的检定和伤害掷骰均加 1。制作者达到 10 级: Choose a simple or military weapon. Add 1 to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. Once the creator reaches 10th level as an artificer, the bonus increases to 2.
选一把简易或军用武器，需同调。用它攻击的命中检定和伤害掷骰均加 1。持握者可用附: Choose a simple or military weapon, which needs to be attuned. Add 1 to hit rolls and damage rolls when attacking with it. The bearer can use a bonus action to turn on or off 30 feet of light and an additional 30 feet of glimmer. The weapon has 4 charges. After the wielder is hit by a melee attack, he can immediately use his reaction to spend 1 shot, causing the attacker to make a Constitution saving throw at your spell DC. If he fails, he will be blinded until the end of the attacker's next turn. Restores 1d4 spent charges each dawn.
选一枚戒指，需同调。佩戴者可用动作恢复自己一个已消耗的三环或更低法术位。戒指使用: When choosing a ring, it needs to be of the same tone. The wearer can use an action to restore a spent spell slot of third level or lower. The ring cannot be used again until the next dawn.
选一根权杖、法杖或魔杖，需同调。持握者进行法术攻击的检定加 1，并无视半身掩护。: Choose a scepter, staff or wand, which needs to be in sync. The wielder adds 1 to magic attack rolls and ignores half-body cover. Once the creator reaches 10th level as an artificer, the bonus increases to 2.
选一种工匠工具、选一种语言: Choose a craftsman’s tool, choose a language
选一种工匠工具或乐器熟练。: Pick a craftsman's tool or musical instrument to become proficient at.
